binding.carries: carry_*_walk, guard_patrol_walk and fetch_carry keep walk's legs and timing (syncWith: walk): switch at the same normalised time
binding.hubs: standing clips start and end on the archetype's hub pose (idle frame 0); seated loops on the sit pose; stick clips on the stick hub
binding.oneShots: clips with loop=false play once and hold their last frame (sit_down, stand_up, walk*_start, walk*_stop, look_around, guard_challenge, <loop>_enter, <loop>_exit)
binding.placementScale: set the actor's placement.scale to the resident's placementScale; root travel, stride and speed in this manifest are at scale 1 and scale with it
binding.skeleton: body joints of every crowd resident equal the library skeleton (referenceSkeleton.skeletonSha256 covers the node rest TRS); the household residents can play these clips too, scaled by hips height (evidence only)

description: Shared clip libraries of the Ealdholt crowd, one per body archetype (EALDHOLT_POPULATION_ART.md sections 4 and 6). Clips-only GLBs: the archetype's 64-joint skeleton as nodes and every clip as a named animation of body-joint rotations plus the hips translation; no mesh, no face-joint channels.

adolescent.propBinding: Each clip's props list the prop id, the bone it rides and `matrix` (bone-local, column-major) for the contract frame of PROP_CONTRACTS (origin at the butt, +Y along the shaft, -Z the working face, Blender axes = glTF joint-local axes). `kitMatrix` is the same grip for the crowd prop kit's node as exported (crowd-v1/props: origin at the main grip, shaft +Z in Blender, vertex data in glTF axes), scaled by the archetype's body scale: set it as the prop node's local matrix under the named bone. Props without kitMatrix carry kitMismatch (what the kit must change) or need no grip (workplace props).

adult-male.propBinding: Each clip's props list the prop id, the bone it rides and `matrix` (bone-local, column-major) for the contract frame of PROP_CONTRACTS (origin at the butt, +Y along the shaft, -Z the working face, Blender axes = glTF joint-local axes). `kitMatrix` is the same grip for the crowd prop kit's node as exported (crowd-v1/props: origin at the main grip, shaft +Z in Blender, vertex data in glTF axes), scaled by the archetype's body scale: set it as the prop node's local matrix under the named bone. Props without kitMatrix carry kitMismatch (what the kit must change) or need no grip (workplace props).

elder-female.propBinding: Each clip's props list the prop id, the bone it rides and `matrix` (bone-local, column-major) for the contract frame of PROP_CONTRACTS (origin at the butt, +Y along the shaft, -Z the working face, Blender axes = glTF joint-local axes). `kitMatrix` is the same grip for the crowd prop kit's node as exported (crowd-v1/props: origin at the main grip, shaft +Z in Blender, vertex data in glTF axes), scaled by the archetype's body scale: set it as the prop node's local matrix under the named bone. Props without kitMatrix carry kitMismatch (what the kit must change) or need no grip (workplace props).
